svg.title: Mitochondrion
svg.desc: Cutaway mitochondrion with outer membrane, inner boundary membrane, folded cristae, matrix, and mitochondrial DNA. Biological basis: Oxidative-phosphorylation complexes occupy the cristae-rich inner membrane, while the matrix contains metabolic enzymes, ribosomes, and mitochondrial DNA.
